completeness: Curated Poly Haven HDRI panoramas for CS2 map authors. Source pages, EXR and HDR formats, creator credits, and preview URLs were checked.

items.name: Qwantani Night (Pure Sky)
items.description: A clear night panorama with the Milky Way and a faint, cool horizon glow.
items.author: Greg Zaal, Jarod Guest
items.requirementLabel: HDRI · Compile in CS2 Workshop Tools
items.compatibility: Download the HDR or EXR panorama from Poly Haven. In CS2 Workshop Tools, use it to create a Source 2 Sky material and assign it to the map’s env_sky in Hammer.
